description: Front A (broad catalog), ODC lane: empty a list by calling the system action ListClear through the compact language (call with args.List), the alternative to copying an empty list. In the O11 lane the same call only has the unit contract of tests/contracts/action-coverage (*-list-operations); this job measures whether the system action resolves in ODC without an explicit reference and whether the Verify accepts it. Headless: it proves the model, not the value at run time.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app (CrossDevice) does not expose a public server action (the live Studio errors); the action stays private and without a consumer in this proof job
